notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mobiles Tycoon! Version 1.0.4 changes:
- Rating balance changes and more accurate reviews
- Devices and screen angles are now changed smoother
- Stores now influence company price
- Fixed bugs with operating systems ratings, creation and sales
- Updated german localization
- Gems number is now shown when you hire a special employee
- Small balance and quality of life changes
Have a nice game!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mobiles Tycoon! Version 1.0.2 changes:
- Stores tab in upgrades: you can invest money in your products distribution to sell more copies and get more fans
- Balance changes: marketing affects fans number, you gain fans faster, sales are higher
- Updated sandbox: you can now edit sales, fans and time flow speed multipliers
- Added “Help with translation” button, so that you can help improving game localization in your language
- Some bug fixes and performance improvements
Have a nice game!
